mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP indicates a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of payroll employment growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when industrial production is above 105.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and GDP indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during periods of increasing housing starts and GDP.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP indicates an easing monetary cycle and a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 0.5 and GDP is above 16500.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when the unemployment rate is below 5.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and housing starts indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during periods of increasing retail sales and housing starts.
